categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Zheneng Electric Power Co., Ltd. primarily operates in power generation including coal-fired power, gas-fired power, nuclear power, combined heat and power, and integrated energy services. The company also controls Suzhou Zhonglai Photovoltaic New Material Co., Ltd., which focuses on photovoltaic auxiliary materials, high-efficiency solar cells and modules, and photovoltaic applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes traditional thermal power generation technologies (coal and gas), nuclear power technologies through investments in nuclear power enterprises, and photovoltaic manufacturing technologies including production of solar cell backplanes, high-efficiency cells, and modules. It also invests in energy storage and virtual power plant technologies to optimize resource utilization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are power grid companies and electricity purchasers mainly within Zhejiang Province and other domestic regions, with some international sales. The company serves the electricity and heat supply market, as well as photovoltaic product customers globally.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are mainly concentrated in Zhejiang Province, China, with additional activities in other domestic regions such as Anhui, Xinjiang, Ningxia, and some overseas markets through subsidiaries and investments, including Hong Kong, Italy, Luxembourg, Singapore, and Indonesia.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Zheneng Electric Power operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, focusing on power generation and energy supply. Through its photovoltaic subsidiary, it also engages in upstream manufacturing of photovoltaic materials and components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes high-quality energy supply and green low-carbon transformation, focusing on innovation in energy storage, nuclear power expansion, photovoltaic technology advancement, and digitalization of energy management. It invests in R&D for smart power plants, industrial internet security, and photovoltaic efficiency improvements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through electricity and heat sales, photovoltaic product sales, and related energy services. The company also earns investment income from equity investments and financial assets, as well as government subsidies and other operational income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: As the largest power generation enterprise in Zhejiang Province with significant market share in thermal power and nuclear power investments, the company is positioned as a leading provincial energy supplier. It competes with other regional power producers and photovoltaic manufacturers in China’s growing renewable energy market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 88 billion, a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 7.75 billion, and total assets of RMB 154 billion. The company showed a revenue decrease of 8.31% compared to the previous year but an 18.92% increase in net profit, indicating improved profitability and stable growth in power generation volume.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhejiang Zheneng Electric Power emphasizes reliable and stable energy supply with a diversified energy mix including coal, gas, nuclear, and renewables. Its integration of photovoltaic manufacturing and energy storage solutions enhances its competitive edge in green energy transition. The company leverages strong provincial market presence, advanced technology adoption, and strategic investments to provide high-quality, efficient, and sustainable energy solutions.
